verdict_text: NO. The regex `matrix_re` matches only `attn.c_attn.weight`, `mlp.c_fc.weight`, and `mlp.c_proj.weight`, but omits `attn.c_proj.weight`, so only 36 tensors (3 per layer × 12) are cast to bfloat16 instead of the required 48 — violating Required result clause 1. The script's own assertion checks for 36 bfloat16 tensors instead of 48, so it "passes" its self-check while violating the "exactly 48 tensors are bfloat16" required check from the spec. `h.0.attn.c_proj.weight` will incorrectly remain float32 in the output.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
